verdict.rationale: Bulk import from other authenticator apps is a fair question for any OTP authenticator, so the axis applies. The pack documents only Authenticator's own cloud/iCloud backup and restore, password export for autofill, and per-account QR or manual enrollment; none of these is importing OTP tokens in bulk from another app. With no evidence of a bulk token-import capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, I can import tokens in bulk from other authenticator apps instead of re-enrolling every account by hand
